exchanged.selected_frozen_answer: The 17th Street Canal is in New Orleans, Louisiana (forming part of the boundary with Metairie), and the Beaver and Erie Canal is in western Pennsylvania, running from the Ohio River to Lake Erie through several Pennsylvania counties.
